label: Sidebar + Content
description: Fixed or collapsible left sidebar navigation with a flexible primary content area and top breadcrumbs bar.
responsiveRules: Collapses to bottom nav or hamburger drawer below 1024px; desktop maintains a 240px to 280px left rail.

label: Bento Grid
description: Modern modular multi-span grid featuring diverse card dimensions, micro-dashboards, and high visual hierarchy.
responsiveRules: Single column stack on mobile (<640px), 2-column masonry on tablet (640-1024px), full 3-4 column bento grid on desktop (>1024px).

label: Marketing Landing
description: High-impact storytelling structure with hero section, feature alternating columns, testimonial band, and sticky CTA footer.
responsiveRules: Full-width hero with vertical feature stacks on mobile; horizontally centered max-w-7xl containers on desktop.

label: Dashboard Split
description: Dual-pane operational layout featuring metric KPI headers, real-time analytics graphs, and a right-hand activity inspector.
responsiveRules: Inspector shifts into sliding drawer on tablet/mobile; main analytics panel takes 100% width.
